correctness.rationale: Factorization \(x^{3\cdot2^k}-1=(x+1)^{2^k}(x^2+x+1)^{2^k}\) plus \(f(1)=1\) restricts common factors to \(g\). Residues modulo 3 characterize g divisibility. The 2-adic common difference and a nonvanishing derivative give exact root multiplicity 2^s. CRT counts exact strata, and the quotient generator gives d independent even parity triples repeated r times. Projected subcode support establishes all generalized weights. The standalone checker exhaustively computed gcds for 19561 triples and codeword weight spectra for 66112 words.

value.rationale: This infinite, structurally defined sparse-circulant class has a natural rank and kernel-spectrum question raised by recent invertibility work. The result provides a complete fine-grained rank distribution (including exact multiplicities), determines exactly which of k+1 kernel codes occur, and supplies full Hamming enumerators plus all generalized Hamming weights, information not furnished by the unrestricted rank totals or binary invertibility tests. It is a classification of useful invariants, not an arbitrary single finite example.
